page.overview:
Who is Guerrique de Montrohain?

Ser Guerrique de Montrohain is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward. He is a member of Heavens' Ward.

Ser Guerrique was a Temple Knight who served directly under Ser Zephirin during his tenure as a commander. Ser Guerrique earned much glory during his time as a heavy infantryman. It is said that the Cleaver earned his title when he felled a wyvern with but a single blow of his axe, with an impact so powerful that the beast's head was not severed, but obliterated, the pieces flying apart in a thousand different directions.

Ser Guerrique, alongside his fellow Heavens' Ward, joined Thordan VII in the Singularity Reactor, after the Warrior of Light defeated both Lahabrea and Igeyorhm. The knights transformed into the Knights of the Round and assisted King Thordan in combat against the Warrior of Light.

Upon defeat, Guerrique and the other knights fell to the ground, and were encompassed in a swell of aetheric light.
